format:

        <style>

          }

          .badge {

            text-transform: uppercase; color: #7C3AED; border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.4);
            border-radius: 20px; padding: 0.35em 1.2em; margin-bottom: 2rem;
            background: rgba(124,58,237,0.08); animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.1s both;
          }

            font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
            font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.05;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7C3AED 0%, #06B6D4 55%, #10B981 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text;
            margin-bottom: 0.7rem; animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.2s both;
          }
          .subtitle { font-size: 0.95rem; color: #94A3B8; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.3s both; }
          .audience {
            font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase;
            color: #7C3AED; opacity: 0.8; margin-bottom: 3rem; animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.35s both;
          }
          .cta {
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.2rem 2.8rem;
            border-radius: 16px; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #F1F5F9;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.2), rgba(6,182,212,0.1));

          .divider { width: 50px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,0.1),transparent); margin: 2rem auto; animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.55s both; }
          .acts { display: flex; gap: 0.7rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.6s both; }
          .pill { font-size: 0.58rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid; }

          .p3 { color: #10B981; border-color: rgba(16,185,129,0.35); background: rgba(16,185,129,0.08); }
          @keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(20px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }
        </style>
